comment:
* the interface stream ciphers conform to.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public void init(boolean forEncryption, CipherParameters params) throws IllegalArgumentException
methods.comment:
* Initialise the cipher.
     *
     * @param forEncryption if true the cipher is initialised for
     *  encryption, if false for decryption.
     * @param params the key and other data required by the cipher.
     * @exception IllegalArgumentException if the params argument is
     * inappropriate.

methods.name: public String getAlgorithmName()
methods.comment:
* Return the name of the algorithm the cipher implements.
     *
     * @return the name of the algorithm the cipher implements.

methods.name: public byte returnByte(byte in)
methods.comment:
* encrypt/decrypt a single byte returning the result.
     *
     * @param in the byte to be processed.
     * @return the result of processing the input byte.

methods.name: public int processBytes(byte[] in, int inOff, int len, byte[] out, int outOff) throws DataLengthException
methods.comment:
* process a block of bytes from in putting the result into out.
     *
     * @param in the input byte array.
     * @param inOff the offset into the in array where the data to be processed starts.
     * @param len the number of bytes to be processed.
     * @param out the output buffer the processed bytes go into.
     * @param outOff the offset into the output byte array the processed data starts at.
     * @return the number of bytes produced - should always be len.
     * @exception DataLengthException if the output buffer is too small.

methods.name: public void reset()
methods.comment:
* reset the cipher. This leaves it in the same state
     * it was at after the last init (if there was one).
